chunks: Ali ibn Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Imran ad-Daqqaq - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Muhammad ibn Abi al-Kufi quoted on the authority of Musa ibn Imran an-Nakha’ee, on the authority of his uncle Al-Hussein ibn Yazid al-Nowfali, on the authority of Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Abi Hamza, on the authority of Yahya ibn Abi al-Qasim, on the authority of As-Sadiq Ja’far ibn Muhammad, on the authority of his father, on the authority of his grandfather, on the authority of Ali (peace be upon them all).

The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The Imams after me are twelve, the first of them is Ali ibn Abi Talib and the last is the Qa'im (the Riser). They are my Successors, my Trustees, my Masters, and God’s Proofs for my nation after me. Whoever bears witness to them is a believer, and whoever denies them is an atheist.'
ai.seo_question: Who are the twelve Imams according to Shia hadith and what is their spiritual authority?
ai.summary: Recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, this hadith serves as a foundational proof for the number and identity of the Twelve Imams, explicitly naming Ali as the first and Al-Qa'im as the last. It elevates their status to 'Hujjat Allah' (Divine Proofs), establishing a theological framework where acceptance of their authority is synonymous with true faith and rejection constitutes disbelief.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 6-28 Ali ibn Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Imran ad-Daqqaq - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Muhammad ibn Abi Abdillah al-Kufi quoted on the authority of Musa ibn Imran an-Nakha’ee, on the authority of his uncle Al-Hussein ibn Yazid al-Nowfali, on the authority of Al-Hassan ibn Ali ibn Abi Hamza, on the authority of his father, on the authority of Yahya ibn Abil Qasim, on the authority of As-Sadiq Ja’far ibn Muhammad (s), on the authority of his father (s), on the authority of his grandfather (s), on the authority of Ali (s) that God’s Prophet (s) said, “

There are twelve Divine Leaders after me. The first one of them is Ali ibn Abi Talib (s) and the last one of them is the Riser. They are my Successors, my Trustees, my Masters, and God’s Proofs for my nation after me. Whoever bears witness to them is a believer, and whoever denies them is an atheist.”
